heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Showers continuing route 4 south. Lows in the mid 40s to low 50s. Northeast wind around 5 mph south, otherwise light.

heading: Monday
text: Mostly cloudy. Rain showers mainly south of Route 2. Highs from the upper 50s south, to mid-60s north. Light north to northeast winds near 5 mph south.

heading: Monday Night
text: Some clearing developing overnight in the northwest, otherwise mostly cloudy. Rain showers tapering off west to east. Lows in the 40s to near 50.
